business.description: UCAL Limited is a leading manufacturer of Fuel Management Systems and critical automotive components with over four decades of industry experience. The company has evolved into a global solutions partner in mechatronics and advanced technologies for automotive and non-automotive industries worldwide.

outlook.statement: The future of mobility will not be one technology replacing another. It will be several coexisting — advanced electronics, digital integration, intelligent systems, electrification and sustainable engineering solutions — each demanding a different capability from suppliers. Breadth of capability, not bets on a single outcome, is what will separate the partners of choice from the rest.

India is expected to remain one of the fastest-growing automotive markets in the world, supported by robust domestic demand, rising exports and rapid technology adoption. Electrification, connectivity, emission compliance and driver-assistance systems are all raising the electronic and mechatronic content of the vehicle.

UCAL is well positioned to participate in the next phase of mobility transformation with a growing portfolio of new products, expanding customer relationships and a strong foundation of engineering excellence.

UCAL continues to strengthen its innovation ecosystem through strategic collaborations with technology partners, research institutions, academia and industry bodies to accelerate technology development, shorten product development cycles and enhance speed-to-market, supporting evolution into a technology-driven global mobility solutions company.

The Company has drawn up strategic plans to develop its electronics vertical as a strong growth engine by investing in AI-enabled plant and process expansions, creating a large talent pool, and forming strategic technology and joint venture partnerships with domain experts.
UCAL has drawn up strategic plans to expand the automation and robotisation of processes across its manufacturing plants to further strengthen its future-ready capabilities.

As the mobility industry undergoes transformation, UCAL's engineering capabilities and advanced manufacturing solutions position it as a globally trusted technology and manufacturing partner for automotive manufacturers and OEMs worldwide.

At UCAL, quality remains central to the journey towards resilience and business resurgence. By integrating advanced technologies, automation and AI-enabled manufacturing and process controls, together with sustainable practices, UCAL is further strengthening its quality ecosystem to consolidate its position as a global solutions partner.
A strong order pipeline across new products provides a solid foundation for continued growth in the near future.
UCAL is well positioned to participate in the next phase of resurgent growth driven by India's transition towards sustainable mobility and clean energy.
The Company will continue to strengthen ESG integration across operations, products and partnerships, while aligning with evolving national and global sustainability expectations.
For the year 2026-27, the estimated Capex would be around `45 crores towards normal Capex.

The Indian automotive sector is expected to sustain its growth momentum, driven by strong domestic fundamentals, rising income levels, infrastructure expansion, and continued policy support. Key structural themes shaping the outlook include accelerated electrification across 2W and PV segments, expansion of domestic manufacturing under China+1 strategy, growth in logistics-led CV demand, increasing export integration into global supply chains, gradual shift towards software-defined and connected vehicles, and shift towards Green Fuels - Ethanol / CNG / Alternate Fuels / Hybrids.

Global growth could stabilise in a narrow range of 2.9%–3.1% by 2027, depending on de-escalation of geopolitical tensions, easing of inflationary pressures and normalization of trade and monetary policies. India's growth trajectory is expected to remain strong and stable, with IMF projecting growth in the range of 6.5%–6.8%, supported by structural reforms, productivity gains, and continued infrastructure build-out.

Beyond 2027, the global auto industry is expected to enter a more decisive phase of transformation, with electrification, software integration, and alternative energy platforms becoming central to product strategies. Competition is likely to intensify as new technology players reshape value chains and traditional OEMs accelerate platform consolidation.

The global carburettor market is expected to continue its long-term growth contraction, with demand increasingly concentrated in legacy fleets, aftermarket replacement, and select low-cost applications in developing economies. The aftermarket segment is expected to provide a stable revenue base.

Beyond 2027, the FMS market is expected to transition from a pure ICE-dependent growth trajectory to a hybrid-driven and efficiency-focused ecosystem, where demand is sustained by commercial vehicles, hybrid powertrains, off-highway applications, and developing markets.

Demand for precision-manufactured throttle body and fuel rail assemblies is likely to remain supported by hybrid applications, aftermarket requirements and cost-sensitive markets, creating opportunities for suppliers with strong manufacturing capabilities, value engineering expertise and diversified product portfolios.

Continuing in its path of resilience and resurgence, UCAL has drawn a strategic roadmap aligned to a clearly defined upward trajectory of growth and global expansion. Leveraging its strength as a manufacturer of repute of a wide range of automotive components and global mobility systems, the Company will continue to expand its ambit of operations in emerging segments in a dynamically evolving automotive and non-automotive landscape worldwide.
The Company's product development roadmap is focused on next-generation solutions for the rapidly growing electric vehicle (EV) market and the increasing adoption of electronics in safety, sensing.

The Company's strong engineering capabilities position it to expand its portfolio of advanced electronic control systems, sensing solutions, power electronics, and intelligent mechatronic products, reinforcing its commitment to supporting the next generation of mobility solutions and creating sustainable long-term growth.
Preparedness for Emerging Trends - A sustained focus on next-generation technologies keeps us aligned with shifting market needs and customer requirements.
